description:
Dimensions of Lot are (approximately) 100.00 x 50.00 x 100.00 x 50.00
Nearest Cross Street: E 18th Street
Subject to a Mortgage given to Prospect Park Savings Bank SLA on January 24, 1989, in the approximate amount of $77,000.00 recorded on January 31,1989, in Book 114, at Page 344.
The sale is subject ot unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any condominium/homeowner association liens which may exist. The sale may be further subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record.
The occupancy status of the subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is $207,874.49 calculated through October 28,2025 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriffs costs and commission to the date of the sale.
